# ESP32-S3 SHA-512 placement A/B for fork #94, CPU at 80 MHz: every image

rind's time for each image, in µs: the median over that image's flashes, with the number of flashes (n) and the spread (slowest − fastest flash) / fastest. A ratio is the image's median over the control's (`control`); below 1 is faster than the control. `control` was flashed 3 times; `rolled` was flashed once; `unrolled` was flashed once. An image flashed once has one run, so its spread is 0 and says nothing about repeatability; read it against the control's spread. The RustCrypto column is the median of every flash of every image (the same RustCrypto code in each image, a layout control). Every number here is recomputed from [ab.json](ab.json) by `cargo verify`.
